Organized Villain Crime.text: Organized villain crime in Japan peaked in the chaos years and has been shrinking ever since. Gangs formed around a few strong Quirks, and the old yakuza families recruited powered members and grew rich on the disorder. As licensed heroes multiplied, the state turned them and the police against the big organizations: raids, mass arrests, seized assets, and laws letting the police register and watch any designated villain group. The syndicates broke apart. Today the underworld is lone villains, crews formed for one job, a few watched remnants of the old families, and the brokers who connect them. Any group that grows large draws heroes quickly, so the survivors stay modest and keep their leaders out of sight.
